I used to think standing desks were a scam, honestly, some kind of open-office theater piece. Then my back started acting up after a long stretch of bad chairs and worse posture, and I caved and bought the cheap one, not the nice one, because I still didn't fully believe in it.

Turns out it helps, a little. Not the miracle the ads promise. I stand for maybe an hour a day before my feet complain and I sit back down, which some ergonomics person would probably tell me is the wrong way to do it.

Still beats the old chair. That's about as strong an endorsement as I've got.
